'''Barettal''' is a [[Domani]] soldier under the command of [[Rodel Ituralde]].

== Activities ==
He acts as one of Ituralde's guards during the [[Battle of Maradon]]. He survives the initial attack and manages to limp inside the walls when the [[Saldaean]] relief comes.

==Trivia==
*Barettal is named after Robert Barett, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
